Calcarea Bromata.

Bromide of Calcium. Ca Br2.

Clinical.─Brain, congestion of. Fretfulness. Irritability. Sleeplessness.

Characteristics.─Calc. bro. is an unproved remedy, recommended by Hale in a variety of children's complaints. Suited to children who are of lax fibre, lymphatic, nervous, and irritable. As both Bromine and Calcarea are suited to fair-haired and fat children the combination appears to intensify the effect. Gastric, intestinal, and cerebral irritation in such children. Vomiting, diarrhœa, sleeplessness, fretfulness, and tendency to brain disease.

Relations.─Compare: Bellad., Æthus., Calc., Bro.
